content: Bab-Dummad Abramʼbo igar mesisad
Abram birga-dulabake-gakambe-gakabakebak-nikadgine (99), Bab-Jehová ese magarononikid, ega sognonikid:

content.text: An bebo igar-mesisad, gannar an bega sogbar:

content: Geb degine, Abram Bab-Dummad-asabin napase e-bebe-ebulegedse dulluu imaksad. Bab-Dummaddi ega sogdebalid:

content.text: Ar dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-ambikumaloed-e-dad-dummadga an be-imakosoggu, be bar Abramʼye nugguosulid.

content: Wagan-bukidar-nikuega an be-imakoed. Begine, reymar ainidagoed, degine, yar-baid-baidgi be-waganmar-bukwa an imakoed.
Degisadegu, an bebo igar-mesoed, degine, yoedse be-wagan-ebo an igar mesbaloed. Ani, an degisadegu be-Bab-Dummadga guoed. Degine, be-sorba be-wagan-e-Bab-Dummadga degisadegu an gubaloed.

Emi, Canaán-yala be-yalasur-inigwele, degite, a-yalagi be garmakdiid. We-Canaán-yalade, bela degisadegu an bega uked, degi, be-sorba, be-waganga an ukbaloed. A-yalade, degisadegu bemargadga guoed. Deginbali, ani, an be-wagan-e-Bab-Dummadga gubaloed.
Deginbali, Bab-Dummad Abrahamʼga sogdebalid: —Be, degi, bela be-wagan degisadegu anbo-igar-mesnaidba be nanamalo.
Weyob an bebogwa igar-mesnaid, be-wagan we-igar-mesnaidba imakmarmogoed: ‘Bela bemar-abargine, masmala e-abgan-uka-duku sikmaloed.’
”Bemala be-abgan-uka-duku sikergebed. Weyob we-ibmar-imakedgi bemar-anbogwa-igar-mesisad mag daklegoed.

Emi-ibagan-onodoedgi, bela masmala, ibabaabakgus (8) gwalulegedgi e-abgan-uka-duku ega siklegoed. Deyob degibi be-wagan be imakmarmogoed. Be-wagansurmalad amba deyob imakmarmogoed. Be-mai be-neggi gwalulesaddibe, be-mai manigi be dule-baidse baksaddibe, amba deyob be imakbaloed.
Be-mai be-neggi-gwalulesaddibe, be-mai manigi be dule-baidse baksaddibe, wemar e-abgan-uka-duku-siksuli be imakosulid. Weyob an bemar-ebo igar-mesnaid be-abgangi degisadegu mag daklegoed.
”Ar dule e-abgan-uka-duku siksulile, we-dule bemar-abargi onolegergebed. Ar bemarbo an-igar-mesisad-sogedba imaksasulid agala onolegergebed.”
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad Abrahamʼga sogdebalid: —Be-ome bar Saraiʼye nugguosulid. Emi-onodoedgine, Saraʼye nugguoed.

Be-omegi ise-nued an binsaoed. Bemarga machigwa an ukoed. Eye, napiragwa, be-omegi ise-nued an binsaoed. Sara dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-ambikumaloed-e-nanaga guoed, degine, e-wagana dulemar-e-reyga gumaloed.

Abraham napase e-bebe-ebugedse dulluu imaksad, geb allided. Agi, binsaded: “¿Ar wede dule-birga-dulatar-nikad (100) sunna babga gusi? ¿Ar wede Sara birga-dulabake-gakambe-nikadgi (90) sunna nanga gusi?”
Geb degi, Abraham Bab-Dummadga sogded: —¡Bitigi Ismaelʼgi be nued binsaena gadin! An-sorba bela an-ibmarmar Ismaelʼgadga guena gadin.

Bab-Dummad Abraham-abin sogded: —Suli. Deyob guosuli. Ar an bega soged, be-ome-Sara bega mimmi bakoye. A-machigwa Isaacʼye be onugsao. An bebo-igar-mesisadi, be-machigwa-Isaac-ebo gannar we-igar an obinogoed. Ar degisadegu Isaac-e-wagan-ebo we-igar mai guoed.

”Emi, be-machi-Ismaelʼga be ibmar-egichisadi, an be-itosbalid. Be-machi-Ismaelʼgine ise-nued an binsamogoed. Mimmigan-bukidar-nikuega an imakoed, degine, wagan-bukidar-merguega an imakbaloed. Ismael, dule-dummagan-nuga-nikamalad e-ambe-gakabogwad-e-dadga (12) an imakoed, degine, e-dulamar ichesur an imakoed.
An-bebo-igar-mesisaddina, Isaac-ebogwa igar-maigu an imakoed. Sara birgagwense we-ibaganse bega mimmi bakoed.”
Bab-Dummad Abraham-ebo-sunmaknaid-bergusgua, nade gusad.

A-ibagi-gines, Abraham e-machi-Ismael-e-abgan-uka-duku siksad. Ar igi Bab-Dummad ega sogsa, bela e-maimar-e-neggi-gwalulesmalad, bela e-maimar manigi-baklesad, degi, belagwable machergan-e-neguyagi-gudidimalad e-abgan-uka-duku-sikega imaksad.
Abraham birga-dulabake-gakambe-gakabakebak-nikadgi (99), e-abgan-uka-duku siksad.
Ismaelʼdi birgambe-gakapaa-nikadgi (13), e-abgan-uka-duku ega siksamalad.
Abraham, degi, e-machi-Ismael-ebo iba-galagwen abgan-uka-duku-siked-igar imaksamalad.
Machergan-bela-Abraham-neguyagi-gudidimalad, e-maimar-e-neg-yagi-gwalulesmalad, dule-baidse maimar-manigi-baklesad, amar Abrahamʼba belagwable abgan-uka-duku-siked-igar imaksamalad.
